 NBA GAME THREAD: Miami Heat (2-5) look to bounce back against struggling LA Clippers (1-6)
 151 Comments 
 / By 
 Surya Fernandez 
 / November 4, 2026 
 The Miami Heat hit the road to Los Angeles to take on the Clippers inside Intuit Dome. (Photo Courtesy of the NBA) 
 The Miami Heat continue their West Coast road trip tonight as they visit the Los Angeles Clippers at Intuit Dome, looking to bounce back from a disappointing defeat against the Lakers.
 Miami enters Wednesday’s matchup with a 2-5 record after suffering a 138-117 loss to the Lakers on Monday night, snapping the Heat’s two-game winning streak.
 Giannis Antetokounmpo continued his strong start to the season with 30 points, 12 rebounds and seven assists, while Klay Thompson added 19 points and Bam Adebayo contributed 16 points and nine rebounds. Unfortunately, the Heat couldn’t slow down Los Angeles defensively, allowing the Lakers to shoot over 57 percent from the field.
 Defense has been one of Miami’s biggest concerns through the opening seven games, and Erik Spoelstra will be looking for a much stronger effort tonight.
 The Clippers have endured an even more difficult start, entering the game at 1-6 and riding a five-game losing streak. Led by Darius Garland, Los Angeles has struggled to find consistency and will also be without several important players due to injuries.
 For the Heat, the goal is simple: tighten things up defensively, continue building chemistry between Antetokounmpo and Adebayo, and get back into the win column before facing the Golden State Warriors on Thursday night.
 Can Miami take advantage of a struggling Clippers team and get its road trip back on track?

 Date:  Wednesday, November 4, 2026
 Time:  10:30 PM ET / 7:30 PM PT

 Miami has an opportunity to respond after Monday’s disappointing performance and begin building some momentum on the road.

 SunManFromDogBone

 WOW! Heat win 117-116 in O.T. Now I need to watch the highlights on youtube. 
 I give Thompson a lot of credit for having the self-confidence to believe he can still perform at a high level when many of us questioned if he still had it. 
 Bam, Giannis and Davion also had good games. 
 Heat need a 5th starter and bench scoring. 
 They also need everyone to play inspired basketball, on defense and offense. 
 The defense finally gave up less than 110 points (during regulation time). To be competitive, Miami should hold opponents to an average of 110 points or less. 
 Their 3 point shooting was terrible (23.1%) compared to Clippers’ (37.2%). Miami needs 3 point shooters in order to be competitive. Ironically, Jaime’s 3 point shooting has improved significantly. He has made 15 of 31 this season with the Bucks (48.8%). 
 At 3-5, the Heat now has a firm grasp on 9th place, 1.0 game behind 4-4 Knicks, Cavs, Raptors and Wizards and 1.5 games behind the 4th place Hawks. 
 After beating the 1-7 Clippers, the road trip continues tomorrow vs 5-3 Warriors, followed Sunday vs 1-7 Kings and Tuesday vs 1-7 Jazz. If they win 3 of 4 they will have a 6-6 record when they return home to face the Cavs and Pistons back-to-back on November 13 & 14 followed by the Rockets on the 16th.

 OT THRILLER ! Klay got ice in his veins with that GW. We was down as much as 20. The mental fortitude of this team to come through like this, I hope this win helps this team grow exponentially. Also Mitchell didn’t shoot the ball well from 3, but came through with timely steals, good D, and double digit assists. I give clippers credit for coming out guns blazing for a team that doesn’t have any 1st round picks for a half a decade. I’m honestly just glad we won, I have negative thoughts, but I won’t let that get in the way of a much needed W, I hope we can build of this win, and this klay GW will go down as heat lore in our team history.
